caption: The drawing depicts a brown wooden barrel with visible wood grain and three metal bands painted in light greenish tones encircling it. The barrel is painted with the words "WATER" near the top and "Lake Erie" near the bottom in yellow letters with green shadows. There is a blue painted background in the center portion of the barrel, and in the foreground, there is an image of a brown eagle with outstretched wings clutching a blue fish in its talons. The background of the picture is a plain beige color with no other objects or details present. The overall composition is centered, and the focus is entirely on the decorated barrel.
title: Keg
